findings.problem: The label "اپ ڈیٹ دوبارہ کوشش کریں" is unidiomatic and reads approximately as "update, try again", rather than clearly naming the action of retrying the update.
findings.fix: Use "اپ ڈیٹ کی دوبارہ کوشش کریں" for an idiomatic, explicit update-retry button label, distinct from "دوبارہ کوشش کریں".
